opening.argument: The video opens by presenting a walkthrough for linking U.S. and Canadian accounts in the RBC Mobile App, then gives specific navigation instructions from the home screen. Entering a U.S. online-banking username and password is shown as a step in that stated workflow, alongside selecting which accounts appear and arranging their display order. Those observable steps support an instructional account-management purpose, not a claim of payment or profit. The material shows no requested fee, promised return, deceptive outcome, or completed transaction. Its limits still matter: the interface's independent authenticity and its handling of credentials are not established by what is shown.

citations.quote: Welcome! In this video we will show you how to link your US and Canadian accounts in the RBC Mobile App.
Start on the home screen of the RBC Mobile App. Press the Manage menu, three-dot button on the right side of the Account Overview area.
Next, enter your US online banking username and password, and hit Link.
then select which US banking and credit card accounts.
You can move your accounts up and down so that they're displayed in the order you prefer.
